verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਭੈ ਭਵਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਾਇ ਕੈ ਚਈਲੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes paraves kar bhai bhavan bhaavanee bhagat bhai chai kai chieele hai ||

en.bdb: Guru-conscious persons imbibe the teachings of the Guru in their hearts. They maintain utmost devotion and love for the Lord in this fearsome world. They remain in a state of bliss by their faith in loving worship and live life enthusiastically.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਮ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੈ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sa(n)gam sa(n)jog bhog sahaj samaadh saadh prem ras a(n)mirat kai rasik raseele hai ||

en.bdb: Enjoying the bliss of the union with God-like Guru and absorbed in a state of inactivity spiritually, they acquire the loving elixir of Naam from the True Guru and are ever engrossed in its practice.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਲਿਵ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਫਬਿ ਛਬਿ ਕੈ ਛਬੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: braham bibek Tek ek aau anek liv bimal bairaag fab chhab kai chhabeele hai ||

en.bdb: By virtue of refuge, knowledge received from God-like True Guru, their consciousness remains absorbed in the Omni permeated Lord. Due to supreme adornment of unblemished feelings of separation, they look glorious and graceful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ-ਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥੪੨੭॥
verses.translit_en: paramadhabhut gat at asacharaja-mai bisam bidheh unaman unameele hai ||427||

en.bdb: Their state is unique and astonishing. In this amazing condition, they are beyond the attractions of body relishments and remain in a blooming state of bliss.  (427)
